comments.author: Lisa
comments.body: West coast of Italy has crafts for grinding this. Naples - ceramics, jewellery, glasswork. Pisa - eye beads, ceramics. Genoa - fine clothing, silverwork. Also even Syracuse - just ceramics. There are also common +2 booster items for sale in Cabo Verde item shop (with effect even) and the ottoman speciallity memo album reward is also a +2 crafts, but no effect. Happy grinding.
